name: linkedin-automation-agent
author: Linn Htet
description: LinkedIn Digital Twin - AI-powered LinkedIn outreach automation using OpenClaw framework

scripts.debug: cd backend && DEBUG=true npm run dev
scripts.debug:full: concurrently "cd backend && DEBUG=true npm run dev" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
